status: Post hoc forensic diagnostic. Original reports unchanged; Q12 results here are not a replacement inferential family.
scope: Last-token residual.embedding within each native model; compare sonnet-pair ranks across models, never coordinate-wise activation values across models.
procedure: Align each original model RDM and cached terminal-token audit by unique sonnet ID.
Group within each model by recorded native terminal token ID; confirm each decoded group maps to one ID.
Measure pairwise-distance spreads for every expected token-pair class, excluding the diagonal, and maximum distance-row differences among identical-token groups.
Inspect unchanged stored embedding blocked permutation statistics, null draws, add-one p-values, and union60 q-values.
Reproduce the original 9999 seed999 within-block label permutations and verify their JSON SHA256.
For the named Q12 diagnostic only, round complete embedding RDMs to 12 decimal places before average-tie ranking; verify bitwise RDM invariance for every recorded blocked permutation.

source_algorithm.cosine: Float64 row normalization, clipped unit @ unit.T; distance = 1 - similarity; only matrix diagonal forcibly zero.
source_algorithm.rank: Exact-value average ties on upper-triangle distances; machine-epsilon splits therefore become distinct ranks.
source_algorithm.permutation_tail: Original code uses null >= observed - 1e-12 after ranking; this does not repair distance ties lost before ranking.

q12_named_diagnostic.policy: numpy.round(float64 RDM, decimals=12) applied uniformly before scipy.stats.rankdata(method=average).

pairs.basis: Bitwise invariant Q12 RDM for every reproduced original blocked permutation; no additional permutation family or FDR calibration.

limitations: This audit uses existing derived RDMs and tokenizer audit metadata; it does not download or reread raw activation tensors or independently prove byte equality of pooled embedding vectors.

Identical-token equality is expected from audited native token-embedding semantics before contextual blocks. Epsilon-scale violations are consistent with float64 normalization/matrix-multiplication roundoff; this audit does not isolate the individual kernel.
Q12 is a documented post hoc numerical policy for sensitivity analysis, not a preregistered model of statistical uncertainty or a universal tolerance for arbitrary distances.

No layer/pooling beyond embedding last_token is assessed by this named diagnostic. Full-family sensitivity requires uniform treatment of every model and baseline RDM and its own declared correction family.

Tiny nonzero numpy.std can arise even for an exactly constant array when the computed mean rounds; unique-value count and maximum deviation from the observed statistic establish the exact Q12 degeneracy.
recommended_policy: Retain lossless raw tensors and original RDM/report artifacts with hashes; mark the affected raw numerical inference as unreliable.
Apply one explicit deterministic rounding policy before all ranks across all model/baseline RDMs in a separately versioned full-family sensitivity; do not choose tolerances per significant result.

For future raw-vector processing, deduplicate exactly identical feature rows, compute unique-row cosine distances once, force same-row distance zero, and expand by inverse indices; test repeated-row and row-permutation invariance.
Add synthetic repeated-vector tests and a terminal-token negative control; never repair this by only widening the final permutation-statistic comparison tolerance.
